headline: ABC reporter saves man from sinking car in floodwater north of Brisbane
standfirst: ABC reporter Will Murray and another man swam out to the car and pulled the driver out of the vehicle.
body_markdown:
ABC reporter Will Murray and another man swam out to the car and pulled the driver out of the vehicle. (ABC News Just In)

**Stuff** adds: An ABC reporter and a bystander pulled a driver from a sinking 4WD after it stalled on a flooded road north of Brisbane.

**The Straits Times Asia** adds: SYDNEY, Oct 22 - An Australian television reporter and a bystander rescued a man from a car as it was engulfed by flood waters on Thursday, footage of the incident showed.

**Al Jazeera** adds: Australian TV reporter rescues man from sinking car
